P.text: A Vault account holds Portfolio Margin supplied balances and borrow debt on HyperCore precompile 0x811; the Accountant counts supplied balances but does not subtract borrow debt.
P.evidence_quote: The Accountant counts Portfolio Margin supplied balances from HyperCore precompile 0x811, but it does not subtract Portfolio Margin borrow debt.

I.text: Total backing accounting must subtract Portfolio Margin borrow debt so that surplus/yield reflects only real surplus.
I.evidence_quote: Monetrix adds the supply side into `_readL1Backing()` but never subtracts `borrow.value`.

V.text: Ignored borrow debt creates false surplus that can be bridged, settled, and distributed as yield, leaving USDM undercollateralized.
V.evidence_quote: This creates false surplus. The normal yield flow can bridge, settle, and distribute that false surplus as yield, leaving USDM undercollateralized by the ignored borrow.
